title: DPR: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
description: Open-domain QA traditionally used BM25 sparse retrieval, which requires exact keyword match. DPR trains two BERT encoders — one for questions, one for passages — with in-batch negatives, enabling semantic retrieval. Shows that dense vectors outperform BM25 on open-domain QA while being indexable with FAISS.
authors: Karpukhin, Oğuz, Min, Lewis, Wu, Edunov, Chen, Yih (Facebook AI)
